reference.title: Compression curves of transition metals in the Mbar range: Experiments and projector augmented-wave calculations

methods.source_location: Article section 2.1 and Supplementary Table S1 caption
methods.notes: Ruby spectra were measured immediately before and after each diffraction measurement for two spheres. NaCl volumes served only as a secondary check where peaks were present.

recalculation.notes: The exact Dewaele et al. (2008) ruby scale is executable in Peritheos and the reported source-scale pressures suffice for an EOS refit, but raw row-wise R1 wavelengths are not published.

assessment.basis: Every compared free coefficient meets both the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison and parameter-specific numerical similarity screen. Error conventions and fit qualifications remain applicable.
qualifications: Phase-specific source inclusion flags are applied. This diagnostic does not replay the MINUTI volume objective and Gaussian parameter priors; a different conditional coefficient estimate alone does not establish a source-EOS failure.

fit.solver_message: Both `ftol` and `xtol` termination conditions are satisfied.

scientific_validation.note: The open publisher article and official supplement were audited directly. The complete source-scale P-V table and the versioned MINUTI equation, weighting, prior, and selection protocol support an independent Peritheos refit.

primary_source_check.finding: The source defines a 14-row, 300 K B1 BM3 fit with all three EOS coefficients refined, K0-prime constrained by a 3.8+/-0.3 prior, and two explicitly excluded pre-transition B1 observations.

primary_data_check.finding: All 28 printed rows are preserved. Fourteen B1 rows are selected, the two anomalous B1 rows are retained with explicit exclusion reasons, and all 12 rhombohedral rows remain in the shared dataset.

independent_refit.objective: MINUTI isothermal effective-variance volume residuals with the source K0-prime prior and N/n prior weighting
independent_refit.notes: Every refitted coefficient lies within the corresponding published marginal uncertainty. Small statistic differences are expected because Table S1 rounds pressure and atomic volume while MINUTI used the underlying reductions.

excluded_branches.reason: SMS constrains magnetic and spin populations at 95.4, 97.0, and 116.4 GPa, but the diffraction P-V table ends at 88.7 GPa and contains no spin-resolved volume observations.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: article sections 2.1, 3, and 3.1; article Figure 1 and Table 1; official supplement Table S1.
parameter_provenance.equation: Article section 3.1 and Table 1: third-order Birch-Murnaghan isothermal EOS; the prose's isolated 'Burch-Murnaghan' spelling is interpreted by the explicit Birch-Murnaghan figure captions and standard equation implemented by MINUTI.
parameter_provenance.V0: Article Table 1: 9.860(7) A^3/atom, freely fitted; multiplied by eight atoms per conventional B1 cell.
parameter_provenance.K0: Article section 3.1 and Table 1: K0T=155.3(22) GPa, freely fitted.
parameter_provenance.K0_prime: Article section 3.1 and Table 1: K0T'=3.79(11), refined with prior 3.8+/-0.3 rather than fixed.
parameter_provenance.volume_basis: Supplementary Table S1 and both EOS figures label volume as A^3/atom. The B1 rocksalt conventional cell contains four formula units and eight atoms, so V and sigmaV are multiplied by eight without changing K0 or K0_prime.
parameter_provenance.temperature_ref: The EOS figures identify the isotherm as 300 K.
parameter_provenance.uncertainties: Table S1 gives parenthetical pressure and volume errors. Pressure error is the reported difference among ruby determinations before and after diffraction; the source gives no confidence convention for volume or parameter errors.

source_lineage.role: published EOS coefficients, phase selection, experiment, and pressure calibration
complete P-V observations and row uncertainties
source_lineage.citation: Dobrosavljevic et al. (2019), official Supplementary Table S1

selection.included: P1-P13, including both P8a and P8b (14 rows)
selection.excluded: P14 at 26.7 GPa and P15 at 30.1 GPa because their P-V trend changes before the cubic-rhombohedral transition

fit_provenance.objective: MINUTI weighted least squares in volume: chi2=[sum((Vobs-Vmodel(P,T))^2/(sigmaV^2+(V/K*sigmaP)^2))+(N/n)*sum((x-X)^2/sigmaX^2)]/(N+p-n).
fit_provenance.covariance_scaling: MINUTI scales its inverse normal matrix by the minimized reduced chi-square; the article publishes marginal errors and error ellipses but no numerical covariance matrix.
